messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Hi Pirjo, I just changed the SFP on TRN-033 at site OULU-03. The link is up and optics look normal, but the counters are at zero and there is no traffic passing through.

messages.author: Pirjo Heikkinen
messages.text: Hi Timo. That is weird if the optical levels are fine. Did you check the far end?

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Far end looks ok. Link is green but zero packets moving.

messages.author: Pirjo Heikkinen
messages.text: I think it might be the SFP batch, maybe try another vendor. I am not 100% sure though, I have not seen this behavior myself before.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Ok, I don't have other brands with me today. I will look for another vendor's SFP tomorrow from the warehouse and try that. Thanks!
